name: Homuha no X 1.5: Sukisuki Date Daisakusen
source: After a tumultuous week, Kou and his twin sister Homuha decide to spend a leisurely day downtown. But due to various circumstances, they end up becoming the most wanted criminals in the city! Can they prevail over the pigs or will they spend the rest of their lives in stripes? Find out in “Homuha no X 1.5: Sukisuki Date Daisakusen!”
translation: 经过忙碌的一周后，Kou和他的双胞胎妹妹Homuha决定在市中心度过悠闲的一天。但由于种种原因，他们最终成为了城里的头号通缉犯！他们能否战胜猪群，还是在条纹中度过余生？在“Homuha no X 1.5：Sukisuki Date Daisakusen！”中找到答案
